title: the first englishman
narrativeQuestion: How does a forgery fool the experts, and what does it break while it is believed?

chapters.title: The gravel pit
chapters.claim: Dawson brought the find to Woodward, a credible amateur and a serious professional.

chapters.title: The announcement
chapters.claim: The scientific name and the press name did different jobs, and the connecting parts were missing.

chapters.title: Why it was believed
chapters.claim: Acceptance speed tracked fit with expectation.

chapters.title: The people who said no
chapters.claim: Correct objections were published early and lost.

chapters.title: The second site
chapters.claim: The confirming site failed every test of independence.

chapters.title: What got built on it
chapters.claim: Textbooks, displays, careers, and a monument rested on the fake.
Fluorine dating reopened the case thirty seven years later.
The manufacture was a human skull, an orangutan jaw, filing and stain.
One method across both sites points to one forger.

chapters.title: The fossil that was real
chapters.claim: The forgery made Dart's genuine Taung child look wrong for about two decades.

chapters.title: What caught it
chapters.claim: No confession. A measurement and a microscope.
